data.name: Daafi
data.gender_notes: Daafi is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'da'fa', meaning 'to press down' or 'soft, gentle'. It can also be associated with the Arabic word 'da'fa', meaning 'leopard'. Therefore, this name can be interpreted as one who is soft and gentle, yet possesses the strength and agility of a leopard. The name Daafi carries the meaning “Soft, gentle” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Daafi usually hope their child will grow to embody soft, gentle and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that evokes the softness and gentleness of nature, while also representing the inner strength and courage of an individual. It is a reminder to remain calm and focused in the face of challenges, while also having the ability to protect and defend oneself when necessary.
data.etymology: Daafi belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Soft, gentle.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Daafi total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
